## WF-08 - Telegram Notifier

Milestone 9. Standalone, reusable sub-workflow following the same pattern as WF-02 through WF-07. Called by WF-07 via an Execute Workflow node. Takes one prepared notification payload, resolves the real Telegram chat ID, formats the message, and actually sends it via the Telegram Bot API -- the delivery step WF-07 intentionally left out.

## Chat ID Resolution

destination.chatId from WF-07 is a placeholder KEY (e.g. TELEGRAM_CHAT_TRANSMISSION_TEAM), not a real chat ID. This node maps that key to a real Telegram chat/group ID via an inline table (this n8n instance blocks $env access from Code nodes, so environment variables were not an option). Open this node and replace each REPLACE_WITH_REAL_CHAT_ID value -- see the Telegram Setup Guide. Unmapped/unconfigured keys fall back to the NOC chat.

## Retry & Error Handling

5. Send Telegram Notification retries 3 times (1s apart) before routing to its error output. On failure: Build Failure Record -> Log Failure -> Error Output - Delivery Failed (the structured error this workflow returns). On success: Return Dispatch Result, including the Telegram message_id.
